protection.allowlist_doc: Spare cells are tagged `(* keep *)` / `setattr -set keep 1`; Yosys opt_clean and `clean -purge` skip keep-marked objects by construction, so the runner's own clean/opt passes never strip them. Spares are inserted as physical instances AFTER abc so no logical optimization pass can reach them in the first place.
